title: Legible, continuous pedestrian path from footpath and parking to entries
text: A legible, well-defined, continuous path of travel is provided from the public footpath and car parking areas to building access areas such as lobbies, stairs, accessways and individual dwelling entries.

replaces.note: row-level crosswalk ch3-079: Part B C6.1-C6.5; R25 and below path 1.2 m -> 1 m, 2.5 m separation and shared-street rules deleted
row-level crosswalk ch3-079: Part C C3.7.8-C3.7.10

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: clause number reused. Chapter 3 C3.7.10 (p42) is the general pedestrian path of travel; Chapter 2 C3.7.10 is battleaxe lighting and landscaping, which is Chapter 3 C3.7.14. 'Legible, well-defined' needs a planner; no evaluator. The measurable communal-street path tests are C3.7.11.
